goals.title: R0 Production Baseline
goals.objective: 实施生产范围冻结、Ubuntu/依赖/浏览器/LLM 支持矩阵、生产配置 fail-closed、setup enrollment、健康探针、测试与发布基线。以 PRD Step 0 和 Test Spec R0/GA-R0-001/002 为唯一验收依据；当前 mutation 保持 disabled。

goals.title: R1 Agent Boundary
goals.objective: 按 PRD Step 1 拆分 Control Plane、Worker 与独立 root Node Agent；完成 Python/Go spike ADR、UDS 权限与 SO_PEERCRED、typed capability、execution grant、replay/fencing、systemd sandbox 和无旁路证明。通过 Test Spec R1 全部 blocking gates 后完成。

goals.title: R2 Durable Runtime
goals.objective: 按 PRD Step 2 建设 DB-backed Worker、canonical task state machine、atomic claim、resource lock、lease/fencing、cancel/reconciliation、实时 SSE、Artifact Store 与审批/grant/queued 原子事务。通过 Test Spec R2 全部 blocking gates 后完成。

goals.title: R3 Security And Data
goals.objective: 按 PRD Step 3 建设 RBAC、MFA/step-up、双人审批、key hierarchy/escrow/rotation、secret encryption、audit checkpoint、versioned migration、off-host backup 与 clean-host DR。通过 Test Spec R3 全部 blocking gates 后完成。

goals.title: R4 Real Domain Gates
goals.objective: 按 PRD Step 4 分别完成 R4A systemd、R4B Docker/Compose、R4C Nginx/Site/SSL、R4D Files、R4E Terminal、R4F MySQL 8.4 LTS/PostgreSQL 15-16/Redis 7、R4G UFW/SSH 的真实纵向闭环；MySQL 8.0.46 仅保留迁移兼容 fixture，不作为新 GA 安装支持。每个 gate 独立 feature flag、manifest、API/UI/E2E、destructive-lab 和恢复证据；七个 Test Spec R4 gate 全部通过后完成。
goals.steeringEvidence: Oracle MySQL 8.0 release notes state 8.0.46 reached EOL in April 2026; official supported-platform and 8.4 docs list MySQL 8.4 as LTS on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
goals.steeringRationale: Production GA must not promise a database line already at end of life; retain 8.0 only as migration compatibility evidence.

goals.title: R5 Product UI
goals.objective: 按 PRD Step 5 建设 Ant Design 后台与 Ant Design X AI 诊断台，完成会话、权限、实时流、审批、任务、报告、专业工具区和七个领域页面；保持真实 API 契约与 canonical cancel UX。通过 Test Spec R5、真实 Safari、可访问性和三连绿 E2E 后完成。

goals.title: R6 Production Operations
goals.objective: 按 PRD Step 6 完成生产安装、非 root 服务、TLS、可复现构建、SBOM/签名、升级回滚、observability、外部告警、artifact/DB 异地备份、运维与支持手册。通过 Test Spec R6、clean VM、篡改/降级负例和灾备验证后完成。

goals.title: R7 Pilot RC GA
goals.objective: 按 PRD Step 7 依次完成 Alpha、destructive lab、Beta、14 天 staging soak、RC、7 天 canary 与正式 GO/NO-GO；使用冻结的真实 LLM contract，满足零未授权 mutation、零永久 running、零审计断链、seeded secret 零命中和同一 RC 三连绿。最终质量门禁通过后完成整个生产 GA 目标。

codexObjective: Complete the durable ultragoal plan in .omx/ultragoal/goals.json, including later accepted/appended stories, under the original brief constraints; use .omx/ultragoal/ledger.jsonl as the audit trail.
